# Kumbh Mela — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("What is Kumbh Mela associated with?", "Indian, Every 12 years"),
    ("What is notable about Kumbh Mela?", "River bathing"),
    ("What is context?", "Indian, Every 12 years"),
    ("What is key fact?", "River bathing"),

]

    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
